name: pawnest
description: PawNest - Better Care. Happier Pets. Full-stack pet-food e-commerce platform (React + Node + MongoDB).

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start --prefix backend
